The API documentation lists four exceptions: UnsupportedOperationException (when add operation not supported), ClassCastException (when element class prevents addition), NullPointerException (when element is null and nulls not permitted), and IllegalArgumentException (when some property prevents addition). Since the calling context does not check or guard against these conditions, none of these exceptions are avoided.

remark: All four exceptions can be triggered because the code does not perform any checks before calling `impl.add`. UnsupportedOperationException occurs if the underlying list does not support the add operation. ClassCastException occurs if the element's class is incompatible. NullPointerException occurs if the element is null and the list prohibits nulls. IllegalArgumentException occurs if the element's property (e.g., a domain-specific constraint) makes it invalid for addition.
